payload.title: Android FrickTransport should support JSON PUT
payload.description: Crate CR-108 migration found Android cannot move app commands to canonical PUT endpoints because FrickTransport exposes post(path, body) and putBytes(path, mimeType, bytes), but no JSON/text PUT. Crate's Square location selection should call PUT /api/square/locations once migrated, but using putBytes for JSON would be semantically wrong and hard for app tests/fakes. Add suspend fun put(path: String, body: String, headers: Map<String,String> = emptyMap()) to the Android SDK transport, implement it in KtorFrickTransport with application/json, and keep source-compatible defaults for existing test fakes.
